# Animotions Studio

> > Professional animation studio specializing in 2D/3D animation, motion graphics, explainer videos, and visual storytelling for brands and businesses.

Animotions Studio offers comprehensive animation services including explainer videos, CGI production, concept art, and video editing. The studio provides educational resources on animation techniques, software tools like Blender and 3ds Max, and industry best practices for creating engaging visual content across social media and marketing channels.

- 3D animation pipeline

- 2D animation
- Visual storytelling

- Video production
- Character design

- 3D modeling
- Blender
- Video editing workflow

- Whiteboard animation
- 3D rendering services
